summary: E2E frontend validation of (1) new LordTraining logo on Landing/Auth/Dashboard and (2) share-link visit-tracking panel in the AthleteProgress modal. Both features PASS. All 3 logo data-testids resolve to tags that load successfully (naturalSize=531x470, complete=true) — Landing nav-brand-logo and Dashboard dashboard-brand-logo use /brand/lordtraining-scale.png; Auth auth-brand-logo uses /brand/lordtraining-master.png. Visit-tracking flow: after seeding 3 calc-1rm results on athlete 'sds' and visiting the public /progress/p/{share_id} URL twice, the share-stats panel inside progress-detail-modal correctly shows share-views-count=6 (incremented), share-first-viewed='25 jun 26, 01:57', and share-last-viewed='25 jun 26, 01:58'. Initial state (before any visits) correctly showed views=0 with first/last as '—'. Public page renders public-progress on every visit.
critical_code_review_comments: AthleteProgress.js line 143 — share-info fetch uses metric_label, while series uses label. Both consistent with backend handlers (verified by 200 responses and incrementing counter). OK.

BrandLogo.js — uses /brand/lordtraining-scale.png for icon/full variants and /brand/lordtraining-master.png only for shield (Auth page). Both files exist in /app/frontend/public/brand/ and load with HTTP 200 and naturalSize 531x470. OK.

loadMeta() is called inside the share() handler after a successful POST /share, so the share-stats panel appears immediately after first share. Verified — panel was already present on modal open (because share_id was reused from prior iterations) and stayed in sync after subsequent visits. OK.

Three console 404 errors appear on athlete detail load (unrelated to logos or share-stats — likely sponsor-logo fetches for absent sponsors or a similar optional asset). Non-blocking, but recommend filtering /sponsor-logo/{sid} 404s to .catch silently or guarding the call when sponsors array is empty.

Existing carry-over goal record (target_value=130 from iter71) for athlete sds + calc-1rm + '1RM Promedio' still present in DB (calc_progress_goals). Caused by the DELETE /goal route-ordering bug reported in iteration_71 (still unresolved). Not in scope for this iteration but flagged for visibility.
Frontend has hardcoded fallback locale-dependent date format via fmtDateTime — verified renders correctly in es-ES ('25 jun 26, 01:57').
